task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the ascii value of a character.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method AsciiValue(c: char) returns (value: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned value is the ASCII code of the input character c
- The value is within the valid ASCII range (0 to 127)
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method CharToAscii(c: char) returns (ascii: int)

Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - There are no preconditions; the method will always work for any character.
    
Dafny specification:
    // No preconditions needed, as any char can be converted to its ASCII value.

Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The returned ascii value is equal to the ASCII code of the input character.

Dafny specification:
    ensures ascii == c as int

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method CharToAscii(c: char) returns (ascii: int)
    ensures ascii == c as int
{
    ascii := c as int;
}
```
